title: F1 Race Prediction - Drift & Model Monitoring

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN prediction THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::numeric, 3), 0) AS live_top10_rate FROM prediction_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes';
SELECT ROUND(value::numeric, 3) AS baseline_top10_rate FROM training_stats WHERE feature = 'top10' AND stat = 'positive_rate' AND is_baseline = true LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Prediction Drift: Predicted Top-10 Rate vs Training Baseline

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, AVG(CASE WHEN prediction THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Live Top-10 Rate", (SELECT value FROM training_stats WHERE feature='top10' AND stat='positive_rate' AND is_baseline=true LIMIT 1) AS "Training Baseline" FROM prediction_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Prediction Confidence: Mean Probability by Model Version

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, COALESCE(model_version, 'unknown') AS metric, AVG(probability) AS value FROM prediction_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Feature Drift: Mean Starting Grid Position vs Training Baseline

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, AVG(grid::float) AS "Live Mean Grid", (SELECT value FROM training_stats WHERE feature='Grid' AND stat='mean' AND is_baseline=true LIMIT 1) AS "Baseline Mean Grid" FROM prediction_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Feature Drift: Grid Z-Score vs Training Baseline (10 min windows)

targets.rawSql: WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN stat='mean' THEN value END) m, NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN stat='std' THEN value END),0) s FROM training_stats WHERE feature='Grid' AND is_baseline) SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '10m'), ABS(AVG(grid::float) - MAX(b.m)) / MAX(b.s) AS "Grid z-score" FROM prediction_logs CROSS JOIN b WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: |live mean Grid - baseline mean| / baseline std. Orange > 0.5, red > 1 (alert).

panels.title: Categorical Drift: Constructor Share Distance vs Baseline (10 min windows)

targets.rawSql: WITH live AS (SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '10m') AS t, constructor_name AS c, COUNT(*)::float / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY $__timeGroup(created_at, '10m')) AS share FROM prediction_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2), base AS (SELECT category AS c, value AS share FROM training_stats WHERE feature='ConstructorName' AND stat='share' AND is_baseline), w AS (SELECT DISTINCT t FROM live), pairs AS (SELECT w.t, COALESCE(l.c, b.c) AS c, COALESCE(l.share, 0) AS ls, COALESCE(b.share, 0) AS bs FROM w CROSS JOIN base b FULL OUTER JOIN live l ON l.t = w.t AND l.c = b.c) SELECT t AS time, 0.5 * SUM(ABS(ls - bs)) AS "Constructor TVD" FROM pairs WHERE t IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t ORDER BY t;

panels.description: Total variation distance between live and baseline ConstructorName shares (0 = same distribution, 1 = disjoint). Serving data comes from newer seasons than training, so ~0.5 is normal. Orange > 0.65, red > 0.8.

panels.title: Categorical Drift: Constructor Share (Live Window vs Training Baseline)

targets.rawSql: WITH live_total AS (SELECT NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::float AS n FROM prediction_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)), live_shares AS (SELECT constructor_name AS constructor, COUNT(*)::float / (SELECT n FROM live_total) AS live_share FROM prediction_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1), base_shares AS (SELECT category AS constructor, value AS baseline_share FROM training_stats WHERE feature = 'ConstructorName' AND stat = 'share' AND is_baseline = true) SELECT COALESCE(l.constructor, b.constructor) AS constructor, COALESCE(l.live_share, 0) AS "Live Share", COALESCE(b.baseline_share, 0) AS "Training Baseline Share" FROM live_shares l FULL OUTER JOIN base_shares b ON l.constructor = b.constructor ORDER BY "Training Baseline Share" DESC LIMIT 12;
